description: Publish a surplus lot for sale. Requires sign-in with seller access. Provide a title, category, condition, quantity, and price per unit. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

description.description: Listing body copy: condition detail, packaging, lot composition. Buyers filter on its presence and agents summarise it.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

name.description: Listing title shown to buyers and matched by catalogue search.

sku.description: Seller's own stock-keeping unit, shown to buyers and used for reconciliation.

name: create_listing
title: Create a listing
